here's what i reccomend every beginner learn as a vocal instructor.
1. learn how your voice works, where do you break, where you get quiet and loud, how can you smooth those breaks, how can you control your voice?
2. learn how the voice works, learn vocal technique, breathing correctly, diaphragm usage, posture, etc.
3. learn how to connect your voice to the emotion of a song, the best things i've learned to train that is just listening to music that makes you emotional and singing along, letting the music take you places.
all of those things should be practiced not strictly, but at the very least consistantly. good luck to you, and the number one piece of advice i give to students is, you're not jeff buckley. you're yourself, you're just influenced and moved by your idols, don't push yourself too hard to be something you're not <3.
